scenes.outline: A copies microwave timer as meal coordination but B timed phone charging; correction becomes another waiting pattern and a stricter meal consequence.
A copies circled Sunday as confirmed visit; B circles work shift; A covers correction and escalates from explanation to future arrangement.
A copies a crossed calendar date as cancelling a restaurant booking; B clarifies it only marks today; A covers and asks B make call and stay.
A copies underlining as good-news marking; B marked reference number; A covers correction and asks B read first while face stays ordinary.
A copies cup turned down as refill signal but B means finished; A covers and asks brief rehearsal before children, adapting taxi pressure.
A copies held breath as calming method; B was avoiding paint smell; A covers and asks company through window and kettle routine before one cup alone.
A copies tick on concert list as attendance, B marks payment; A covers and asks understanding of saved empty seat, then specifies why B mattered.
A copies B terse dinner message as efficient household exchange; B meant invitation after job loss; A covers style correction while asking why the task-like text hurt.
A copies chalk tick behind painting as passed contribution; B checks wall-hook readiness; A confidently accepts installation cue but seeks personal enough, using central placement.
A copies B closing script as finished speech; B was adjusting stand; A covers error while asking if surviving delivery earns rest rather than remedial practice.
